posts.title: Ice Gel
posts.description: A conceptual cosmetic product design featuring surreal 3D compositions. The Ice Gel series explores the boundaries between product visualization and abstract art, combining organic blob forms with precise industrial design and dramatic lighting.
posts.author: AaronCxC

posts.title: Sticker Box
posts.description: A collection of handcrafted stickers and print materials. This project showcases the tactile beauty of analog design elements – from bold typographic treatments to expressive illustrations, all presented on natural kraft paper.
posts.author: JanMitGun

posts.title: Pocket Multipass
posts.description: A conceptual hardware device design exploring the intersection of retro gaming aesthetics and modern technology. The Pocket Multipass features a distinctive form factor with premium materials and tactile interface elements.
posts.author: oxxupe

posts.title: The House
posts.description: A cinematic exploration of architectural spaces, light, and shadow. This video piece captures the essence of domestic environments through careful composition and atmospheric visuals.
posts.author: AaronCxC

posts.title: Mask Sculpture
posts.description: An interactive 3D visualization of a sculptural mask form. Explore the intricate geometry through rotation and wireframe overlay, revealing the mathematical beauty hidden within organic shapes.
posts.author: AaronCxC
